description: Create a video entirely from a text description. MODELS: gen4.5 (flagship), veo3.1 (best + audio), veo3.1_fast, kling_4 (Kling 4.0, 3-30s, up to 1080p), kling_4_flash (Kling 4.0 Flash, 720p, 3-20s, cheapest Kling), seedance2_5 (Seedance 2.5, 4-30s, 480p to 4K, audio), seedance2_5_flash (480p/720p, audio), gemini_omni_flash_1.2 (Google, 3-15s, 360p to 4K, needs a prompt), hailuo3 (MiniMax Hailuo 3, 5-15s, resolution 768p or 2k), h3_max (MiniMax H3 Max, 5-15s, resolution 480p or 768p, no ratio), wan3 and wan3_prime (Wan 3, 2-30s, 480p to 1080p, audio), grok_imagine_1_5 (xAI, 1-15s, resolution 480p to 1080p), grok_imagine_1_5_lite (1-15s, cheap), happyhorse_1_0 (3-15s, 720p/1080p). Models made by others take only their own options; a wrong one is refused with the reason, nothing is charged. Their prices are estimated from Runway's published rates. WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll or use wait_for_runway_task.

audio.description: Generate audio (veo, seedance2_5(_flash), wan3(_prime)). Default: true.

duration.description: Seconds. gen4.5: 2-10 (default 5). veo: 4,6,8 (default 8). Models made by others: their own range (default 5).

negative_prompt.description: What should NOT appear in the output (veo models only, max 1000 chars). Omit to use the default negative prompt.

prompt_text.description: Detailed video description. Max 1000 chars for gen4.5/veo; models made by others take more (kling_4 26000, wan3 20000, seedance2_5 15000).

ratio.description: Output size or shape. Runway models default to 1280:720. Models made by others each take their own list (e.g. auto_720p to follow the image, W:H sizes, or shapes like 16:9) and default to a 720p size; an unsupported one is refused with the list. gen4.5/veo: 1280:720 or 720:1280.

resolution.description: Only for hailuo3 (768p, 2k), h3_max (480p, 768p), grok_imagine_1_5 (480p, 720p, 1080p) and happyhorse_1_0 from an image (720p, 1080p). Defaults to 720p or 768p.

name: generate_video_from_text
